title: Task PR status revalidation is throttled by TTL and concurrency cap
answers: Why does the PR badge state take up to 30 seconds to update?
Where is the limit on background GitHub checks for task PR status?
Why is getTaskPrStatus not calling GitHub on every row render?
body:
Host-side PR status revalidation must stay bounded because every visible row can trigger a lookup.
- task-pr-status.ts `TaskPrStatusService`: `REVALIDATION_TTL_MS` (30s) skips a repeat check of the same task via `lastRevalidations`.
- A changed `cloudPrUrl` bypasses the TTL, so a PR a run just opened gets its color at once.
- `MAX_CONCURRENT_REVALIDATIONS` (4) is enforced by `withRevalidationSlot`; extra checks queue.
- In-flight dedupe via `taskPrRevalidations` runs first, then the TTL check.
- Removing any of these makes per-row lookups (up to 50 rows in the work column) hammer GitHub. Tests in task-pr-status.test.ts cover all three.
- Trade-off: PR state changes may show up to 30s late.
